stops.note: named a variety of hot chili pepper
the pepper's name was folk-associated with the French Guianese port city of Cayenne
stops.meaning: a hot ground chili pepper, named after the city

stops.note: borrowed into English as the pepper became a common spice in Atlantic trade
stops.meaning: a hot, ground red chili pepper

current_meaning: a hot, ground spice made from dried red chili peppers
